The hood curves upward into the windshield in a way that defies standard automotive sheet metal stamping, creating a bulbous, organic look rather than a mechanical one.
The front grille lacks a repetitive mesh pattern, appearing as a smudged dark patch. Headlights are undefined glowing blobs rather than structured optical components.
